meta.title: Claude Code Style Lite
meta.description: A lite fork of dsh-claude-style: keeps the Claude / DeepSeek themes, model picker, sessions and statistics; reasoning text arrives directly while the thinking row stays as the host folds it; sound cues and system notifications can mark a task that finishes or waits on you; the stepped reasoning window, peak-rate meter, sent-message entrance animations and drawn caret are removed.
